The term '''pillow-friends''' refers to a [[wikipedia:homosexual|homosexual]] relationship between two individuals, most commonly between two women. It is most prevalent in the [[White Tower]].

[[Novice]]s and [[Accepted]] commonly enjoy these relationships as comfort during the hardships of White Tower training, but are viewed as a thing of girlhood{{ref/book|11|25}} and are almost universally abandoned upon gaining the [[shawl]]. Some attempt to continue the relationships as Aes Sedai.

This has the equivalent term of '''heart-friends''' in [[Seanchan]] slang.{{ref/book|9|20}}{{ref|Bethamin ... wrote a suggestion that Zushi be moved from the Palace to somewhere she could be kept in a double kennel with a ''damane'' from the Empire, preferably one experienced in becoming heart-friends with newly collared ''damane''. Sooner or later, that always put an end to tears.}}

*[[Siuan Sanche]] and [[Moiraine Damodred]]{{ref/book|0|17}}
*[[Ailil Riatin]] and [[Shalon din Togara Morning Tide]]{{ref/book|9|13}}
*[[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] and [[Meidani Eschede]]{{ref/book|11|25}}{{ref|Meidani... scurried from the room breathing hard, her eyes wide... Elaida laughed. "We were '''pillow-friends''' as novices," she said."}}
*[[Galina Casban]] and [[Tarna Feir]]{{ref/book|11|25}}{{ref|Pillow-friends were common among novices and Accepted, but girlhood things should be left behind with girlhood. Not all sisters saw it so, certainly. Galina had been quite surprised when Tarna refused her advances after gaining the shawl.}}
*[[Kiruna Nachiman]] and [[Bera Harkin]]
*[[Seaine Herimon]] and [[Pevara Tazanovni]]{{ref/book|8|26}}{{ref|She smiled at Seaine and Pevara, a monarch perhaps unsure how gracious she should be. "I saw the pair of you sniffing about like ferrets at the hencoop," she said, "but I held my tongue - you might be pillow-friends, for all I know, and whose business is that but yours?"}}

Therava’s jaw tightened. She might have taken the woman [Galina], but ''da'tsang'' belonged to no one. "I intended to dress her in ''gai'shain'' robes of silk," she muttered.}}{{ref/book|8|11}}{{ref|Plucking the rod from Galina's limp hands, Therava tucked it behind her belt as she straightened. For some reason, she gave a pleased smile at that.}}{{ref/book|10|9}}{{ref|Galina was pretty, but nowhere near beautiful, and Faile did not understand what Therava saw in her, unless it was simply the pleasure of dominating an Aes Sedai. "The last time Therava thought you'd poked your nose where she didn't want it, everybody inside a hundred paces could hear you squealing and begging."}}

==Author's clarification==
{{quote|Well, you put fifteen-year-old girls in a tower filled with almost entirely women, with their hormones raging on overdrive, keep them away from men, because you can’t afford to lose any of them, and what do you think is going to happen?}}
:Marcon 36 convention in May 2001

{{quote|Pillow friends are '''not''' just good friends. Oh, they are that, too, but they also get hot and sweaty together and muss up the sheets something fierce. By the way, pillow friends is a term used in the [[White Tower]]. The same relationship between men or women elsewhere would be called something else, depending on the country.}}
:[https://dragonmount.com/blogs/entry/326-yet-another-post/ Robert Jordan's Blog] on [https://dragonmount.com/blogs/entry/326-yet-another-post/ September 30, 2005]

{{quote|For the most part, in this world such things are taken as a matter of course. Remember, Cadsuane is surprised that Shalon and Ailil were so hot to hide that they had been sharing a bed even knowing how prim and proper Cairhienin are on the surface. Well, for many it is just on the surface.}}
:The Official Robert Jordan Blog on [https://dragonmount.com/blogs/entry/330-and-one-more-time/ October 7, 2005]
== In the television series ==
The [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|television series]] portrays several characters as LGBT+ which are not confirmed for the book series.
* {{TVlink|Ihvon}} and {{TVlink|Maksim}} are bisexual, being in a relationship with each other, as well as with {{TVlink|Alanna Mosvani}}.
